svg.title: Four ways to delegate experiment design
svg.desc: An illustrative progression, not an industry-standard autonomy scale. For model comparison, a person supplies exact models and fixed settings, and the system runs comparisons. For configuration search, a person defines ranges and the system chooses values. For component search, a person approves compatible components and the system compares components and settings. In agent-led investigation, a person sets the objective and scope while the agent investigates and proposes changes, the runner tests them, and the agent adapts from results. The widths are qualitative. Human authority over allowed changes, evaluation, budget, and adoption stays in place in every mode. All attempts enter one experiment ledger. The memory demo combines agent-led investigation with bounded configuration search.
